correctness.rationale: The exact imposed-resource periodic solution and Monod integrals reduce the growth difference to sign F(T). The coefficient numerator is negative in degrees 2-5, positive 6-15, negative from 16 onward; the rescaled derivative J(T)/T^16 is strictly decreasing, crosses once by its endpoint asymptotics, and F(5)>0 while F/T^6 tends to minus infinity at both ends. This proves exactly two roots; shared crowding cancels in the log ratio, while logistic comparison keeps total biomass positive. Exact symbolic and 2010 executable checks corroborate identities/approximations, not infinite uniqueness by enumeration.

value.rationale: The exact model isolates a meaningful ecological ambiguity: the same mean resource concentration and mean dose produce two selection reversals under pulse-spacing variation. A rigorous no-additional-reversal theorem, two explicit critical periods and strict sign witnesses establish a natural complete classification in a transparent model, beyond a numerical case. The open-parameter witness establishes robustness of at least two reversals. Scope is explicitly limited to buffered resource dynamics and shared crowding.
